title: Debug: Survive Corrupt Data
prompt:
This loader crashes when the stored value isn't valid JSON. Add a `try/catch` around the parse: on failure, return the default `{ theme: "light" }`. Test by storing garbage (`"not-json{{"`) and loading — it must return the default instead of throwing.

Rules:
- try/catch around JSON.parse.
- The catch returns the default.

tests.name: parse is wrapped in try/catch
tests.hint: try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return { theme: "light" }; }

tests.name: corrupt data returns the default
tests.hint: The catch block returns the default object.

tests.name: valid data still parses
tests.hint: The happy path keeps working: try parses and returns the stored object.
